snippet.title: Seal of Fate - Launches on August 27th
snippet.description:
The world of Acmeis is full of drama, danger... and way too many good-looking people with complicated pasts.
Come on! Meet Ginger, get ready to join the adventure, and maybe save the world!

✨ Pre-register now. You don’t want to show up late to this story!
Official Website: https://sof.ujoygames.com/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/seal-of-fate/id6742219952
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ujoy.sof
